$cn=New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection $cs
$cn.Open()
try {
  $cmd=$cn.CreateCommand()
  $cmd.CommandText=@'
WITH target AS (
 SELECT EmployeeId,EmployeeCode,EmployeeName,IsActive,SalaryType,BasicSalary,PieceWageRate
 FROM dbo.Employees
 WHERE EmployeeCode IN (N'M-90001',N'EMPOK-20260723203306',N'M-90020',N'M-0031',N'M-0032',N'M-0034',N'M-0035',N'M-0036',N'M-0037')
)
SELECT t.EmployeeCode,t.EmployeeName,t.IsActive,t.SalaryType,t.BasicSalary,t.PieceWageRate,
 pr.PayrollRecordId,pr.CreatedAt AS PayrollCreatedAt,pr.Status AS PayrollStatus,pr.BasicSalaryAmount,pr.PieceWageAmount,pr.GrossAmount,pr.NetAmount,
 ea.EmployeeAttendanceId,ea.AttendanceDate,ea.CreatedAt AS AttendanceCreatedAt,ea.IsAbsent,ea.WorkedHours,ea.OvertimeHours,
 pw.PieceWageRecordID,pw.CreatedAt AS PieceWageCreatedAt,pw.Status AS PieceWageStatus,pw.Stage,pw.Quantity,pw.WageRate,pw.TotalWage,pw.PayrollRecordId AS PieceWagePayrollRecordId,
 pi.PayrollItemId,pi.ItemType,pi.ItemName,pi.Quantity AS PayrollItemQuantity,pi.Rate AS PayrollItemRate,pi.Amount AS PayrollItemAmount,pi.Notes AS PayrollItemNotes
FROM target t
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM dbo.PayrollRecords WHERE EmployeeId=t.EmployeeId ORDER BY CreatedAt DESC,PayrollRecordId DESC) pr
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM dbo.EmployeeAttendances WHERE EmployeeId=t.EmployeeId ORDER BY AttendanceDate DESC,CreatedAt DESC,EmployeeAttendanceId DESC) ea
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM dbo.PieceWageRecords WHERE EmployeeId=t.EmployeeId ORDER BY CreatedAt DESC,PieceWageRecordID DESC) pw
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) pi.* FROM dbo.PayrollItems pi JOIN dbo.PayrollRecords itemPr ON itemPr.PayrollRecordId=pi.PayrollRecordId WHERE itemPr.EmployeeId=t.EmployeeId ORDER BY pi.PayrollItemId DESC) pi
ORDER BY t.EmployeeCode;
'@
  $r=$cmd.ExecuteReader()
  while($r.Read()) { $values=for($i=0;$i -lt $r.FieldCount;$i++){ if($r.IsDBNull($i)){''}else{$r.GetValue($i)} }; Write-Output ($values -join '|') }
  $r.Close()
} finally { $cn.Close() }
